items.question: Adding together the two early-May 2025 incidents in which barges pushed by different towboats struck the old Vicksburg Highway 80 Bridge, roughly what was the total estimated cost of the harm done?
items.expected_answer: About $2.84 million in total: an estimated $1.9 million for the Rickey Hughes contact on May 1, 2025, plus an estimated $941,000 for the Myra Eckstein contact on May 5, 2025.

evidence.quote: Date May 1, 2025 Time 1454 central daylight time (coordinated universal time –5 hrs) Persons on board 10 Injuries None Property damage $1.9 million est.
Date May 5, 2025 Time 0957 central daylight time (coordinated universal time –5 hrs) Persons on board 10 Injuries None Property damage $941,000 est.

items.notes: Tests linking both reports through the shared bridge and summing the property damage figures from the two casualty summary tables.

items.question: Was it hotter outdoors when the Rickey Hughes tow hit the Vicksburg Highway 80 Bridge or when the Myra Eckstein tow hit it, and what were the readings?
items.expected_answer: It was warmer during the Rickey Hughes contact, with an air temperature of 81°F, compared with 70°F during the Myra Eckstein contact.

evidence.quote: Weather Visibility 10 mi, fair skies, winds 8 mph west-southwest, air temperature 81°F
Weather Visibility 10 mi, fair skies, winds south-southeast 5 mph, air temperature 70°F

items.notes: Tests comparing the air temperature recorded in the weather rows of the two casualty summary tables.
